column2: NOTICE Crane Swing Radius Barricade Sign, Reset Barricade After Each Move, for Construction Sites, 8x12 Rust-Resistant UV-Resistant Aluminum Pre-Drilled Safety Sign by CGAP Safety
column3:

Why this sign matters

Keeps the barricade line moving with the crane so the tail swing area stays marked and stored material or vehicles are not left inside it after a re-position.

Where to post it

Attach to the barricade stanchions or tape reels placed around the crane tail swing on the job site.

Who orders it

Site superintendents, crane operators and signal persons.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards and practice to review for your site: ASME B30.5 (accessible areas within swing radius barricaded); site lift plan. A sign supports your site procedures; it does not replace training or supervision.
